prompt_text: Camera: ARRI Alexa Mini, Anamorphic, oval bokeh, stretched flares, strong highlight bloom | cool rendering, strong highlight bloom, mild halation, visible grain in shadows | 40mm, f/2.8. Her lower eyelids twitch, a wet catch-light breaks into multiple ovals; her breath snags and her gaze locks dead-forward, the face of someone watching a match flare inside her skull. The gold settles to a steady molten shine as the blurred silhouettes continue advancing behind her, growing larger in the bokeh while she holds the stare with a shallow tremor in her blink.
